name: micardashboard
description: This project tracks issuers of Electronic Money Tokens (EMTs) under the MiCAR framework. The dashboard is a simple static site that reads data from a public Google Sheets document and visualises it using HTML and Tailwind CSS.

scripts.check:css: cp styles/tailwind.css /tmp/tw.committed.css && npm run build:css --silent && diff -q /tmp/tw.committed.css styles/tailwind.css > /dev/null && echo 'Tailwind CSS is up to date.' || (echo 'STALE: run npm run build:css and commit'; exit 1)
